data.name: Jakir
data.gender_notes: Jakir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jakir is a name of God in Hinduism, it represents the divine power and strength. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jayati' meaning 'he conquers'. The name Jakir carries the meaning “God's power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Jakir usually hope their child will grow to embody god's power and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jakir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
